column1: # VENUE EVIDENCE — WEEK 11, 2026-11-17. What the official pages print, row by row.
# The owner brief says: "Transcribe the venue of every fixture from the official game centre and publish it".
# This file records exactly what is on the pages, and is honest about which page it came from:
#   * the weekly schedule page prints NO venue field. It prints, under some cards, a hotel-search link whose
#     URL carries destinationAddress.location=<Stadium name>. That is an official-page string, but it is a
#     link parameter, so it is labelled "link parameter only" and never presented as a venue field.
#   * each fixture page (Game Center) prints a "Game Info" block with Location and Stadium fields. Two of
#     the thirteen were read this round (the two shown with a clock time); the other eleven are blank with
#     "not read this round", which is a measured gap, not a missing value to be filled in by inference.
# FINDING (flagged): for Colts at Texans the two official pages disagree on the stadium name - the schedule
#   page link parameter says NRG Stadium and the fixture page prints RELIANT STADIUM. Any feature that keys
#   a stadium lookup (roof, surface) on the venue NAME will silently fail on that fixture. See the Flagged page.
# FINDING (flagged): Vikings at 49ers is printed with a "Mexico City" event chip on the schedule page and
#   ESTADIO BANORTE / MEXICO CITY on the fixture page, while the model of record (PR-01) adds a 1.6-point
#   home edge to the nominal home club. The rule is frozen for this window, so the edge is published as the
#   rule states it and the venue conflict is recorded as a limit of the rule, for the next registration.
